title: Evaluate conformance during native task closure
context: The commit targets redundant native task completion turns. Host-closed tasks can resume without a new report event, requiring conformance to be refreshed before closure. Touches invariant(s): con_03a0b94b2e (The agent hook must never block an edit on failure: any error exits 0 and never denies; after the event is recognized it emits at most one 'grounding unavailable' context line, unrecognized input emits nothing); con_e04226bd05 (The MCP server must stay client-agnostic: all assistants point to the same .hunch/ graph; no Claude-only behavior in the server).
decision: Run conformance evaluation during native closure for the latest session task when it has deliveries and is open or host-closed. Reevaluate before deduplicating identical results, and reject conformance writes to earlier session tasks.
consequences: Repeated native Stops omit identical conformance events while still reevaluating rules.
Changes to HEAD or stored rule revisions can affect evaluation even when working-file hashes are unchanged.
Older task conformance cannot be redirected into a newer session task.
Closure proceeds if conformance evaluation fails.
alternatives_rejected: Skip reevaluation based only on the working-file hash.
Append identical conformance results on every native Stop.
